description: Ministry of City Planning, Water Supply & Higher Education - Order to appoint Mr. H. M. V. B. Herath to be the Competent Authority for the Gampaha Wickramarachchi  Ayurveda Institute, w.e.f. 01.02.2019
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (A. Ibathul Rauff Hakeem) and details his ministerial portfolio ("Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education"). It also names another individual (Major General (retired) Herath Mudiyanselage Udaya Bandara Herath) and provides detailed responsibilities for his appointment as Competent Authority, including the specific powers and functions he will exercise. This combination of named individuals with detailed responsibilities qualifies it as a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
